## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or requirement.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and any checks unavailable, with reasons.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Scope and architecture match the approved requirements.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; failed or unavailable checks are disclosed.
- [ ] No credentials, private audio/transcripts, models or generated output are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices remain accurate.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
